risk_score: Overall risk score combining multiple factors
success_rate_sem2: Percentage of courses passed in second semester
failure_rate_sem2: Percentage of courses failed in second semester
academic_performance_score: Weighted combination of grades and success rates
curricular_units_2nd_sem_approved: Number of courses passed in second semester
family_support: Composite score of scholarship, tuition status, and family situation
grade_improvement: Change in grades from first to second semester
displaced: Whether student is displaced from usual residence
